# Identical cells under a descent that treats them alike

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`identical-cells-under-a-descent-treating-them-alike` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](identical-cells-under-a-descent-treating-them-alike.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Under a descent moving every cell by one rule from its own state and a field read off the states alone, cells alike at the start stay alike; with the field exchangeable, among configurations of one size the minima of a symmetric free energy come in exchanged pairs, a unique one with its cells alike.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Exchanging cells k and k + 1 of a configuration, the list of the cells' states, keeps their number, leaves a total over the cells unchanged and commutes with mapping every cell (exchangeAt and three more). (`Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.exchangeAt`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.total_exchangeAt`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.map_exchangeAt`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.length_exchangeAt`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Under a descent moving every cell by one rule from its own state and a field reading no cell's number, two neighbouring cells alike at the start are alike at every step, and all cells alike stay all alike: equal states get equal successors (two_alike_stay_alike, all_alike_stay_alike, nth_map, nth_replicate). (`Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.two_alike_stay_alike`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.all_alike_stay_alike`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.nth_map`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.nth_replicate`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. Where no exchange of cells changes the field, as the summed field of the other cells does not, the descent commutes with exchanging two neighbouring cells (descent, Exchangeable, othersField, othersField_exchangeable, descent_commutes). (`Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.descent`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.Exchangeable`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.othersField`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.othersField_exchangeable`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.descent_commutes`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. The commuting law applied: a start the exchange fixes stays fixed along the run (keeps_exchange_fixed, by Law.Commutes.keeps_fixed); the run from the exchanged start is the exchanged run, and rests come in exchanged pairs (exchanged_run, by Law.Commutes.iterate; rests_exchanged); a configuration is exchange-fixed exactly where the two cells are alike (alike_of_fixed, fixed_of_alike). (`Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.keeps_exchange_fixed`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.exchanged_run`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.rests_exchanged`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.alike_of_fixed`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.fixed_of_alike`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Among configurations of one number of cells, the minima of a free energy symmetric in the cells, as one summed from each cell's own at an exchangeable field is, come in exchanged pairs, and a unique minimum has its cells alike; across numbers of cells a summed free energy is uniquely least only at no cells (Symmetric and six more). (`Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.Symmetric`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.freeEnergy`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.freeEnergy_symmetric`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.minimum_exchanged`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.unique_minimum_alike`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.apart_not_unique`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.unique_across_sizes_empty`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. In TwoCells each of two cells moves one unit away from the other's expectation, staying at a tie, and the step commutes with the exchange; from [1, 1] the cells rest, and from any two alike cells the free energy is six at every step, above the nothing of [0, 3] (give and ten more). (`Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.give`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.field`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.away`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.step`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.energy`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.step_commutes`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.alike_rests`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.alike_energy`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.pair_of_alike`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.alike_never_least`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.run_length`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. From [1, 2] the cells are at [0, 3] from step one on, from [2, 1] at [3, 0]; both have free energy nothing, the least, so no two-cell configuration is the unique minimum among two-cell configurations; other configurations reach nothing too (parts, exchanged_parts, minima, other_minima). (`Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.parts`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.exchanged_parts`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.minima`, `Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees.IdenticalCells.TwoCells.other_minima`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. A configuration is the list of the cells' states, of any type; the descent is any rule from a cell's own state and the field it senses; the field reads the configuration, never a cell's number, and is exchangeable where a law says so.
- Modelling choices: discrete synchronous steps; exchanges of neighbouring cells only; minima compared among configurations of one number of cells, since a summed free energy is least at no cells; natural-number free energies; the witness's states from nothing to three; pointwise, with no function extensionality.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That the 2015 paper's simulations fail: they break the symmetry by random initial expectations.
- Densities, variational free energy or continuous time. With noise the law does not apply, as independent fluctuations can part alike cells; what holds instead for finite Markov chains, an exchangeable law, is stated in the periphery.
- Exchanges of any two cells in the pure core, shown in the periphery for every rearrangement (ofFn_rearranged), or which asymmetry differentiates actual cells.
- Which configuration, differentiated or not, is better.
- **Counterexample:** In TwoCells two cells at [1, 1] rest where they started (TwoCells.alike_rests), and from any two alike cells the free energy stays at six, above the nothing of [0, 3] (TwoCells.alike_never_least), while a start differing by one unit parts them to either end (TwoCells.parts). <a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Symmetry breaking needs an asymmetric cause (Curie 1894, Journal de Physique 3); morphogenesis from a homogeneous state needs disturbances an instability amplifies (Turing 1952, Philosophical Transactions B 237). Against Friston, Levin, Sengupta and Pezzulo (2015, Journal of the Royal Society Interface 12, 20141383), whose identical cells minimizing free energy from one location are said to be guaranteed unique places; their simulations start from random expectations, so the law forbids the guarantee read for a deterministic descent from a symmetric start, not the simulations (UE1's search, candidate 1, graded b). Never parting needs only a descent reading no cell's number; the commuting law (what-a-commuting-law-keeps-apart) gives the exchanged run and the paired minima, beside the obstruction for codes and roles in 05 §9; uniqueness is symmetric choice (Angluin 1980; Relabel.EquivariantChoice.withholds_of_full_tie). Graded in UE16's NOTE.
